composition.serve_who: This distribution schedule sheet serves almost all 24V DC systems across the vessel (pumps, lighting, navigation, safety, and general loads). The evidence is the drawing title '+24 V DC DISTRIBUTION' and the exhaustive list of specific equipment loads wired to the Aft, Forward, and Emergency panels via individual breakers.

facts: Main 24V DC distribution panel for aft and general vessel loads.
Primary bus receives 24V DC from 24V SERVICE SUPPLY main trunk via 200A fuse F6 and main switch SW7.
Monitored inline by current transformer CT8 (QI-POWER-485-LV).
Houses distribution breakers Q1-Q54 and a standalone B&G tap block.
24V DC distribution panel for forward loads.
Main bus is fed directly by a connection originating from the top of the AFT PANEL main bus.
Includes a separate emergency bus section at the bottom for breakers QE1-QE4.
Bus is fed from the +24V EMERGENCY BATTERY.
Monitored inline by current transformer CT7 (QI-POWER-485-300-LV per note DWG 111a).
Secondary emergency distribution panel for highly critical loads.
Bus fed from the main emergency power supply.
Houses breakers CB5-CB8 which distribute via terminal strip T/S E.

discarded_as_clutter: Empty breaker slots: Q33, Q34, Q53, Q54, QE2 (FWD), QE3 (FWD), QE4 (FWD), QE5
uncertainties: Fuse number and switch number for the TENDER WINCH supply are partially illegible (labeled F? and SW? on sheet).
The exact function of the 'Re/' block next to the standalone B&G line on the Aft panel is unclear, assumed to be a relay or network module.
Diamond numbers (70, 95, 35) on the main input feeds are assumed to be wire cross-section in mm2 but are not explicitly labeled as such on this sheet.
